title: Cosmic Desert Vision
description: Three women with colorful stylized faces and ornate headwear stand in the foreground looking toward a winding golden path that leads to a vibrant domed city built into a large hill. A massive red sun sets behind the city while two glowing spiral galaxies float in the purple sky above.
prompt: Three stylized women with magenta, turquoise, and pink skin stand in profile in the foreground, adorned with intricate facial markings and ornate headdresses. They gaze across a winding golden path toward a colorful domed city built on a green hill. A giant red sun sets behind the city, casting dramatic rays, while two glowing spiral galaxies swirl in the purple and orange sky. Psychedelic desert landscape with floating patterns, vibrant fantasy style.
